prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: []
1: ["Bring Your Pet to Life", "Upload clear photos of your pet from different angles to create your custom desktop companion."]
2: ["How to Interact with Your Pet", "Learn how to summon, move, and chat with your new companion right from your desktop toolbar.", "Got It"]
3: ["Find Your Perfect Pet Companion", "Answer two quick questions so we can match you with the ideal desktop pet personality."]
4: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Name your companion to claim your official desktop owner badge and unlock custom pet behaviors.", "Official Pet Owner"]
5: ["Sign In to Restore Your Desktop Pets", "Use your registered email to keep all your adoptable pets, saved traits, and desktop settings synchronized.", "Continue with Account"]
6: ["Preparing Your Pet's Desktop Home", "Your companion is getting ready to appear on your desktop toolbar."]
7: ["Don't worry! You can adopt more companions or switch paths anytime in your desktop app settings."]
8: ["Welcome Your Desktop Pet!", "Click launch to spawn your pet directly onto your active desktop toolbar."]
9: ["Select any standard pet for instant desktop spawn, or choose custom creation to build from photos!"]
